request.prompt: [Subject & Action] An architectural visualization of digital storefront analysis: a stylized glass miniature store pavilion surrounded by floating assortment mix rings, brand share pie charts, and customer traffic light trails. [Style & Aesthetics] Contemporary architectural 3D render, frosted acrylic walls, warm timber bases, glowing orange and sapphire accent beams, Octane render. [Lighting & Atmosphere] Cozy interior warm glow combined with modern architectural studio lighting. [Composition & Constraints] Widescreen 16:9 landscape aspect ratio, centered hero perspective, no text, no watermark.
